verdict.rationale: Hatchet is a background task and workflow orchestration platform with cron triggers, durable multi-step workflows, workers, and concurrency controls that run autonomously without manual intervention, and community threads confirm real production use replacing Celery/RabbitMQ setups. It also explicitly supports orchestrating AI agents and exposing workflows as autonomous tools for agent frameworks. missing for 10: dedicated case studies of AI-native users specifically configuring autonomous background automations versus general background task orchestration, and no independent benchmark of long-running autonomous reliability at scale beyond anecdotal scaling issues reported.
